newsitem.title: MEXICO: CITICORP LIKELY WINNER IN ABACO BID - BANKER.
newsitem.headline: CITICORP LIKELY WINNER IN ABACO BID - BANKER.

text.p: Citicorp's Citibank is likely to win a bid to buy Mexican financial group Abaco, the president of the Mexican Bankers' Association said on Wednesday.
"It appears already to be a fact that Grupo Abaco will stay in the hands of a foreign bank. It is a foreign bank called Citibank," Antonio del Valle told a news conference.
He said Citibank had worked in Mexico for at least 30 years and said the transaction would bring foreign participation in the Mexican banking sector to 17 or 18 percent.
He said Mexican financial group Banorte was the most likely candidate to buy up troubled Mexican bank Banpais BPS.N, taken over by the government in March 1995 when internal fraud was discovered.
"In the short term the chance of another foreign bank acquiring a Mexican bank is unlikely," del Valle said, adding there were no other credit institutions that required such participation.
Del Valle said foreign banks would still be welcome in Mexico but there was no urgent necessity for greater involvement.
